policy: A control is never 'implemented' merely because a document describes it; implementation requires an executable check.
A critical executable control requires at least one red fixture proving the gate actually fails on a real injected violation.
Absence of application/database/frontend code is represented honestly as not-yet-built, not as a passing or skipped control.
'partial' means a real, currently-passing executable check exists but does not yet cover the full required scope; the gap is named in notes.

evidence: packages/money/src/{currency,minor-units,money,rate,rounding}.ts: Money's `minorUnits` field is a branded bigint (MinorUnits); there is no code path, overload, or cast that accepts a JavaScript `number` as an authoritative amount

scripts/check-money-safety.ts: a real TypeScript-compiler-API (ts.createSourceFile + AST traversal) static gate now scoped to `packages/money/src/**/*.ts` AND `packages/contracts/src/**/*.ts` (not a global grep) that rejects bare Number(...)/parseFloat(...)/parseInt(...) calls, unary `+` numeric coercion, an object-literal `minorUnits`/`amount` property with a numeric-literal initializer (unsafe JSON money shape), a `z.number()` Zod schema on a minorUnits/amount-named field (numeric transport schema), and a plain `number` type annotation on any amount/money/minorUnits-named field — verified to have zero false positives against both packages' own doc-comments and legitimate patterns (Number.isSafeInteger, string-valued minorUnits/InstantWire, an unrelated `sign: number` field)

Phase 3B: packages/contracts/tests/money-transport.test.ts + money-transport.property.test.ts prove the whole domain -> transport -> JSON.stringify -> JSON.parse -> transport -> domain round trip is exact at 2^53-1 / 2^53 / 2^53+1 and the PostgreSQL bigint bounds, with zero precision loss

This is explicitly the canonical-DOMAIN-FIELD-representation half of DET-05, not RFC 8785 canonical JSON DOCUMENT serialization (key ordering, whitespace, etc. across an arbitrary JSON document) — no request hashing/signing exists, so DET-05 remains not fully closed; this is additional partial evidence, not an upgrade to a different state
red_fixtures: check-authority-integrity.ts --self-test registry-drift-sensitive fixtures (alter rule_verbatim, omit V08, etc., plus Phase 2.1's new stack-seal/position-seal fixtures, all cause byte-identity/completeness to fail)
red:toolchain-mismatch (scripts/red.ts) for 'hidden toolchain change', plus Phase 2.2's 5 isolated single-component toolchain fixtures and the lockfile-disagreement fixture
doctrine_verification_controls.notes: Proven only for the governance-registry generation layer (doctrine/stack/position -> governance/*.json), the toolchain pin layer, and now (Phase 3A + 3B) a small, growing set of narrow application-layer canonical-form invariants. NOT proven for the application/financial system as a whole: there is no migration, ledger, or generator determinism to test yet, no request hashing/signing (so DET-05's canonical-JSON-DOCUMENT half remains untouched, only the canonical-domain-FIELD half advanced), and GOV-05's 'complete verification bundle' is not yet fully assembled (no CI execution observed from this environment — confirmed in Phase 2.2 that no git remote is even configured here — no application dependency graph beyond 4 packages, and the toolchain lock itself still has the SCC-04 compat-engine gap, now more precisely documented). Marking this V-control implemented for the whole doctrine would overstate reality; 'partial' remains the honest state. Phase 3B's addition (exact Zod pin + 3 more canonical wire-string invariants) is real but intentionally narrow and does not by itself close the gap to 'implemented'.
doctrine_verification_controls.revisit_trigger: When application-layer generators (codegen, migrations) exist and can be shown to regenerate byte-identically with a red fixture for hidden toolchain change at that layer too, when request hashing/signing exists to prove the canonical-JSON-DOCUMENT half of DET-05, and when the SCC-04 compat-engine gap is closed.
